d: A chartered helicopter crashed near Chai village in Joshimath, Uttarakhand, while flying from Badrinath to Sahastradhara heliport on a pilgrimage route. The Trans Bharat helicopter carrying six people, including pilot Captain Himanshu and passengers Pratap, Arun, Shankar Gowda, Sudhir K, and S S Nataraj—all from Bengaluru—lost contact while crossing the Joshimath valley after taking off at 1:14 pm.
